book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Taŋgo pileniŋgam tuku pasa
Ne taŋgo afu tuku maŋau pile ndaniŋga le Kuate nu ne tuku maŋau mata pilewe nda.
Ne nane afu pileniŋgit ta maŋau ndui tambi Kuateŋge ne pilenamŋgat. Ne nane afu mbolŋge maŋau kate ta maŋau ndui tambi Kuateŋge ne mbolŋge kamŋgat.
Ndaŋam naŋe am mbolŋge ail baŋ minit le ne kaŋger ndamba naŋe tira tuku am mbolŋge am sumbi kaŋgermba sakate.
Ndaŋam tuku ne tira ta sate: Ye ne tuku am mbolŋge am sumbi ta saukamŋgit ŋgate.
Ne yabri taŋgo ndo. Ne amboŋga naŋe am mbolŋge ail baŋ ta paska. Ne am purfewa le naŋe tira tuku am mbolŋge am sumbi ta saukam kumuŋ.
Kuate tuku wam magenu kame ta age nda niŋgap. Nane mbilka tane maketiŋbekaig. Kuate nu wam magenu tiŋgit ta mbo tugumŋge pan ndakap. Nane agaŋ magenu ta ake agaŋ ŋga totobekaig.
Kuate yabaŋam tuku pasa
Ne wam ande tam tuku Kuate yabaŋmba dirnaŋga ta tanmbimŋgat. Ne wam ande sota mina ta te-silikamŋgat. Ne malaŋga ande katkata ta talke tanmbimŋgat.
Ima nu wam ande tuku Kuate yabaŋmba dirnaŋgate ta nu tate. Ima nu agaŋ ande sota minit ta nu te-silika tate. Ima nu malaŋga katkatmba minit ta nu talke tuwit.
Tane ŋgamukŋge ande kiŋo nuŋe nyamagaŋ yabaŋte le nu lafumba ndame tuwit e?
Ko kualegaŋ yabaŋte le mbeŋ tuwit?
Tane kilke mbol mbal une ŋak ta taŋgine kiŋo kame agaŋ magenu niŋgig tuku. Taŋgine Mam samba mbolŋge minit nu purfeŋnu ndo. Nu tane tuku maŋau limba nu yabaŋde mbal agaŋ magenu niŋgit.
Nane afu ne mbolŋge maŋau magenu kuwaig ŋga idusmba nzalinate taŋamba ndo ne nane afu mbolŋge ka. Tukul pasa tuan taŋgo kame tuku pasa tugunu not.
Malaŋga fudiŋndo tuku yaba pasa
Tane malaŋga fudiŋndo sinam kambim tuku saŋgri tiŋga minap. Ŋgisikam tuku malaŋga suŋgokanu. Ndin mata wam bada kuga. Taŋgo pino gudommba ndin ta dubimba sinam kinig.
Abo tugu tam tuku malaŋga fudiŋndo. Ndin mata kambim tuku minde bada. Nane ndui ndui ndo ndin ta te-silika dubimba sinam kinig.
Yabri tuan taŋgo tuku pasa
Tane yabri tuan taŋgo tuku riroŋkap. Nane sipsip tuku ŋgaro kaika sipsip magenu minet minet ŋga tane tugum prode ta nane age ŋguikok ndo.
Naŋgine wam kile-mayokkade ta mbolŋge katesewamŋgaig. Tane suwar ail mbolŋge apasin alonu kilig e? Ko tane ulem mbolŋge mar alonu kilig?
Taŋamba ndo ail mayenu nu alonu magenu ndo kile-mayokkate. Ail ŋayonu nu alonu ŋaigonu ndo kile-mayokkate.
Ail mayenu alonu ŋaigonu kile-mayokkam kumuŋ kuga. Ko ail ŋayonu alonu magenu kile-mayokkam kumuŋ kuga.
Ail alo mage ndade ta ŋakmba pike lika pa mbolŋge kile-pankade le uge sulude.
Yabri tuan taŋgo nane wam kile-mayokkade ta mbolŋge tane katesewamŋgaig.
Nane ye nyu ta Suŋgo ŋgade mbal ta afu Kuate kulatkate ma mbol kine nda. Ye tuku Mam samba mbolŋge minit nu tuku nzali dubide mbal ndo ma ta mbol kaŋgaig.
Ait suŋgo mbolŋge taŋgo suŋgomba ye teŋenmba sayamŋgaig: O Suŋgo, sine ne tuku nyu mbolŋge dir pasa bitekŋga bukla ŋaigonu pitaika maŋau kitek saŋgrinu gudommba ke likigeŋ ŋga sayamŋgaig.
Taŋakuwaig le ye nane kilimok saniŋgamŋgit: Ye siŋka tane gilai. Tane maŋau ŋaigonu kanu mbal tane kua kape ŋgamŋgit.
Wande patinu tuku yaba pasa
Ima nu ye tuku pasa ise mayemba ka kumu-kumute ta nu taŋgo teŋen. Taŋgo ande nu wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak wande palmbim ŋga ndame sugo mbolŋge makek tugunu ndame patika daŋŋgina taŋaŋ.
Ŋgumneŋga sawe suŋgo piymba kule suŋgo ndeka bubre saŋgrinu tiŋga wande ta kulisokŋga buruna kande wande sur ndakina. Wande ta makek ndamembi daŋŋgina tukunu wande saŋgri ŋak minna.
Ande nu ye tuku pasa ismba nda dubite ta nu taŋgo teŋen. Taŋgo ande nu wamdus kuyar mayenu kugatok wande palmbim ŋga fulbul mbolŋge ake makek tidiŋgina taŋaŋ.
Ŋgumneŋga sawe suŋgo piymba kule suŋgo ndeka bubre saŋgrinu tiŋga wande ta kaduna le surka ndeka fudu ŋayona ŋga nane saniŋgina.
Yesus nu pasa ta ŋakmba sake deŋpurna le maŋgur suŋgo ta nu tuku wam pagu pasa isnaig ta tuku ndek pirerek purkinaig.
Nu kusem pasa tugunu bitekŋganu mbalŋge nane tumniŋginaig taŋamba nu nane tum ndaniŋgina. Nu pasa miro taŋaŋ tumniŋgina.
